name: select

frames.best_why: Framework menu is open with a tick on the current pick and every option readable.

tagline: Thin bordered dropdowns that open a short ticked option list.
summary: A form of single-choice dropdowns: a 'New project' card holds Framework and Region, with a Timezone control beside it. Each closed box shows its value and a chevron, and opens a dark panel of options.
appearance: Two dark outlines on black: a 'New project' card with Framework and Region fields, and a bare Timezone field to the right. Each closed control is a thin bordered box with the value on the left and a chevron on the right; the open one is a dark panel of short rows with a tick beside the current pick.
behaviour: Clicking a dropdown fades and zooms open a panel of options; moving down highlights a row and choosing one closes the panel and swaps the trigger text. The current value keeps a tick beside it.
demo_content: Frameworks Next.js, Remix, Astro and Vite; regions Washington, Frankfurt and Singapore; timezones grouped by continent.
search_phrases: choose a framework from a dropdown
form field with a chevron list
menu with a tick on the current value
dropdown in a new project form
box that lists options when clicked
use_when: A form needs one value picked from a short list that can be grouped under headings.
avoid_when: The closed box holds one line only, so long option names are clipped with an ellipsis.
customise: You compose triggers, groups, headings, items and separators; trigger width and content positioning are props, and colours come from classes.
weight_why: A small portal panel with a few rows; nothing runs while it is closed.

a11y.note: Type-ahead, arrows, Escape and linked labels come from the primitive, but the zoom and slide ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: The Timezone field sits outside the card with no panel around it, unlike the other fields
The open menu overlaps the Region field below it
polish_why: Ordered form with clear selected ticks; the stray Timezone field and overlap look unfinished.
title: Select
